svg.title: A client has been fitted with hearing aids for the first time and is being taught how to care for them. Which of the following client statements indicate an understanding of the teaching?
svg.desc: Mild soap on the mold only, removing the battery during extended storage, and using the lowest setting that avoids feedback are the core points of hearing aid care. Alcohol and hairspray both damage the device, and hairspray residue in particular clogs the microphone opening.

g.text: STUDY HUB / QUESTION MAP
Hearing Aid Teaching
Read the situation
A client has been fitted with hearing aids
for the first time and is being taught how
to care for them. Which of the following
client statements indicate an
understanding of the teaching?
What fits here
I will wash the ear mold with mild soap
and water and keep the rest of the device
dry · I will turn the aid off and take the
battery out when I put it away for the
night · I will keep the…
Why it fits
Mild soap on the mold only, removing the
battery during extended storage, and using
the lowest setting that avoids feedback
are the core points of hearing aid care.
Alcohol and hairspray both damage the
device, and hairspray residue in
particular clogs the microphone opening.
